text:
carmen: Quick sync — proposing a formal semver gating + partner compatibility playbook for Partner API/SDK changes. Need agreement on what counts as 'breaking', deprecation windows, and partner notification cadence. @eng-runtime @marketplace-team @partner-success

jordan: What's the trigger for a 'major' vs 'minor'? e.g., removing a field vs tightening validation?

suhas: Proposal: Major = wire/contract changes that can break clients or change output schema. Minor = additive fields or opt-in flags. Deprecation window: majors = 90 days, minors = 30 days. Also propose a 'preview' / 'beta' label for breaking changes we want partners to test.

lee: Runtime note: changes that affect KV cache layout or model response formats can silently break long-lived connections. We need a compatibility header and server-side shim. Suggest `X-Redwood-Compat: <semver>` plus a server response header for `X-Redwood-Compat-Status`.

anna: From partners: marketplace and SI teams want a clear compatibility matrix per release and a short migration guide. Also request a "no-surprise" alert 2 weeks before public announcement so SIs can schedule migration work.

ben: Legal: any change that affects contractual SLAs or data handling needs 60 days notice. Privacy/security-impacting changes must trigger DPA/legal review.

carmen: OK — action items to capture: 1) semver rules doc 2) partner-facing changelog template 3) migration shim spec + header conventions 4) announcement/runbook + marketplace preview hold window 5) rollback/playbook + canary guidance.

jordan: I'll draft the semver rules + release labels (canary/beta/stable) and add a CI merge check that blocks major bumps without a partner ticket.

suhas: Quick example of the header flow I'm imagining: 
```bash
curl -H "X-Redwood-Client-Version: 2.5.0" \
     -H "X-Redwood-Compat-Policy: warn" \
     https://api.redwood.ai/partner/feature
```
Server can respond with `X-Redwood-Compat-Status: incompatible` and include `Retry-After` + a JSON `migration_hint` URL. That lets partners opt-in to early testing and see automated hints.

lee: We should publish a lightweight compatibility test harness partners can run during preview. I'll start a repo `github.com/redwood/partner-compat` with contract tests and a smoke runner.

anna: :thumbsup: Also ask: can marketplace listings include a "partner-preview" toggle so partners can opt in to pre-release testing and bundle the migration guide in the listing? That would help SIs coordinate.

carmen: Yes — add that to the runbook. Action owners: @jordan = semver doc + CI; @lee = compat test runner; @suhas = header spec + migration guide; @anna = partner runbook + marketplace preview flow; @ben = legal checklist. I'll coordinate partner outreach and draft the first notification email.

deploy-bot: reminder: canary deploy window open 2026-05-11T18:00Z for `partner-compat-playbook/v1`

anna: One more partner ask: a single-page migration checklist SIs can hand to customers. Can someone create a concise markdown with examples?

suhas: I'll author the migration checklist + example snippets and ping for review.

carmen: Great — next sync in #partnerships next Tue 09:00 PT. I'll post agenda here and include a draft notification email. Thanks everyone!
